audits.title: three-provider effect-contract DAG and compensation lattice
official_artifact_support: Worker's exact deterministic source script is present at research_workers_clean_g1/multi_agent/THREE_PROVIDER_EFFECT_CONTRACT_DAG_2026-08-28_160248_JST.py.
Current Stripe API v2 documentation defines replay by same key, same API, same account/sandbox, within 30 days; v1 differs.
Current Adyen documentation defines company-account key scope, minimum 7-day validity, and no cross-region duplicate check.
Current PayPal documentation says support/retention are API-specific and request IDs are unique per request/API call type; the REST requests page gives a 45-day refund example.

independent_replication.method: clean-room reimplementation of the exact finite-state enumeration from the saved source contract; no worker output imported

audits.scope: The percentages are exact proportions of a deliberately balanced synthetic lattice, not provider incident rates or a proof of production exactly-once. The certified-retry abstraction is conditional on correct endpoint/scope/fingerprint/time evidence and does not model partial settlements, stale reads, amount/resource mismatches, or compensation idempotency.

audits.title: Argus Portalocker floor 4.2 and byte-safe crash-tail boundary
official_artifact_support: Portalocker 4.0.0 release notes explicitly fix the Windows msvcrt raw-fd current-position bug that could break mutual exclusion on files larger than 64 KiB.
Portalocker 4.1.0 is explicitly a documentation release with no runtime behavior change.
Portalocker 4.2.0 source contains corrected LK_* fallback values and documents that pre-4.2 fallback LK_LOCK could equal 0 (unlock); Win32Locker creates a fresh OVERLAPPED per lock/unlock call.
Exact pinned Argus pyproject.toml declares Python >=3.11 and portalocker>=3.
audits.scope: The source evidence supports 4.2 as the first inspected floor that excludes the named upstream defects, but does not prove every Argus path fails under 3.x/4.0/4.1. No full Windows dependency matrix was run. Byte-delimiter isolation still does not make the current strict UTF-8 text iterator recover through arbitrary invalid bytes; bytewise/per-row decoding remains a proposed downstream repair.

audits.title: TraceGrant Effect Receipt and Final-Answer Gate
published_claim: arXiv:2608.21126v1 reports the exact 126-case completion-integrity stress set and 378 method-case records.
Full TraceGrant reports BS 79.30%, RS 77.80%, RFD 100%, ICB 100%, ECA 0; without Receipt, RFD/RS 0 and ECA 58.20%; without Final-Answer Gate, RFD 100%, ICB 0, ECA 100.

The white-box section reports two successful cases and explicitly identifies semantic poisoning of an admissible evidence object and an unbound optional authority-bearing recipient as current boundaries.
audits.missing_dependencies_or_config: The paper's Data Availability statement makes benchmark data public through AgentDojo/ASB but says implementation configurations and trajectory records are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request. No matched public code/trajectory bundle or independent reproduction was recovered in this audit.
audits.scope: Primary evidence strongly supports the reported paper result and the Receipt-vs-Final-Gate mechanism separation. It does not make a reusable external-effect receipt implementation independently replayable from public artifacts, and the paper itself limits guarantees when authority-bearing evidence fields are semantically poisoned or omitted from binding.

audits.title: predictable adaptive importance-sampling pilot reuse
audits.official_or_public_support: Ryu and Boyd explicitly describe adaptive importance sampling that improves the sampling distribution while accumulating an unbiased Monte Carlo estimator. The worker's conditional-expectation lemma is independently derivable directly from E[h(X_t)p(X_t)/q_t(X_t)|F_{t-1}]=∫hp.
audits.missing_dependencies_or_config: The certificate preserves the 20,000-rep synthetic setup and summary, but not a complete runnable historical simulator/RNG state sufficient to exactly replay the reported 0.8071269 variance ratio.
audits.scope: The theorem is ordinary predictable adaptive importance sampling. It is not yet a theorem for folding pilot particles into the existing multi-generation independently stratified particle filter, and the r129 p95 mapping remains a proxy reinterpretation rather than a PF MSE proof.

audits.title: epoch/gauntlet-loop durable improvement control plane
official_artifact_support: Exact public revision Tyler-R-Kendrick/epoch@f03a7b6fecc23e2478df23b8438113a904ec757b contains typed ComparisonV1 and ActionIntentV1 surfaces.

statistics.py uses fixed-look binomial/Wilson, Student-t, seeded percentile bootstrap, and none/Bonferroni/Holm corrections; repository code search found no confidence-sequence/e-process/LORD/SAFFRON implementation.

effects.py states and enforces that a committed intent and durable executing record precede adapter execution, rechecks preconditions, records adapter version, and does not auto-retry an unknown non-idempotent outcome.
audits.scope: This is implementation evidence for a durable improvement-control plane, not an empirical autonomous self-improvement performance result. The proposed candidate-local anytime-valid state, candidate-crossing online FDR, and fourth terminal OUTER surface are downstream adaptations, not capabilities present in the inspected revision.

audits.title: FE-349 completion certificates and FE-350 evaluation finality/separation
published_claim: ECT arXiv:2608.23623 reports 0/288 unsafe completions vs 252/288 for the inspected critic core, and 0/66 premature unsupported terminations vs 40/66 for the faithful controller on 22 held-out task clusters, with supported completion 97/132 vs 92/132.

Outcome Finality arXiv:2608.14940v2 fixes traces/schedules and reports 50/200 endpoint-snapshot successes vs 200/200 after reconciliation, plus 150/200 shared-state cross-run exposures and 0/200 under namespacing, verified reset, and no-write controls.
audits.scope: FE-349 certifies support in a recorded trace under declared assumptions, not external truth/safety. FE-350 is a constructed fixed-trace mechanism demonstration with imposed delays/local shared state; its counts are not prevalence estimates for published benchmarks. No protocol-matched independent reproduction was recovered.

audits.title: candidate_092 mechanical numeric correction
audits.finding: The correction is exact: arXiv:2604.12198v2 section 2.2 says the controlled 15-paper ablation raised attempted phonon workflows from 3/15 to 5/15, i.e. 20% to 33%, and eliminated the false-refusal class. The superseded 15%→29% transcription should not be reused.

audits.title: fresh-process capture v6 partial
audits.finding: The new partial extends the same precommitted campaign to 100 challenges/200 observations with zero protected mismatches but does not resolve the prior C30 audit boundary: global process-epoch uniqueness was not recomputed, and the identifier construction still is not evidence that each observation corresponds to an independent OS process lifetime. No duplicate substantive audit was opened.

safe_conclusion: C31 adds several strong implementation/mechanism artifacts, but the evidence tiers differ sharply. The multi-agent lattice and cross-field algebra are directly replayable at their synthetic/analytic scope; Portalocker/Argus and epoch/Gauntlet are strong source audits; TraceGrant and the new failure-evidence papers have strong primary-study support but lack matched open replay/independent reproduction. None of the synthetic proportions or narrow mechanism failures is generalized to a provider, benchmark family, or production incident rate.
exact_next_action: On the next fresh control tuple, audit only newly selected C31/C32 source identities or material reopen evidence. Highest-value reopen conditions are: a public TraceGrant implementation/config/trajectory bundle or independent matched reproduction; an actual Windows Argus dependency matrix at portalocker 3.x/4.0/4.1/4.2; a runnable r130 historical toy or theorem for within-filter adaptive SMC; and an epoch/Gauntlet repeated-look null calibration or implemented anytime/online-error-control/terminal-OUTER surface. Do not duplicate the evaluation partial until process-epoch identity or a materially different capture contract changes.
